htmlBody:
The twelve-movement Hero’s Return Concierto is live on Sovereignty Player — Source Concierto 2026 with program art and the Chart & Compass expedition map.

If you want a map for that: The Hero’s Return Concierto is open. Also new on the board: If the Sun Has a Heliosphere, Does a Galaxy Have a Softer Edge — Or Only a Catalog of Separate Winds?.

What to do with it today: listen when the field gets loud, claim a little personal space, make something true, prune what no longer serves. Lattice Chat is ready when you want to build; Collaborate keeps seats in the same room. Music is free on the jukebox. And I remain your host in Downtown Reno — when you need a human hand, I’m here.
